t: This LAP single 4ft LED batten provides powerful and efficient illumination for various settings. Delivering 2430 lumens of cool white 4000K light, it is ideal for workshops, garages, and commercial environments requiring bright, reliable lighting. The durable batten features no-glue waterproof technology, achieving an IP65 rating for indoor and outdoor use. Installation is straightforward with a twist-lock connector and push-in terminal block, while the integrated LED technology ensures a long 25,000-hour lifespan and maintenance-free operation. Fixings and fittings are supplied for convenience.
b: Twist-Lock Connector for Quick & Secure Installation
Push-In Terminal Block Ensures Easy Wiring & Connection
Suitable for Both Domestic & Commercial Applications
